title: Danny and the Carrot with Two Legs
synopsis: Danny finds a forked carrot at harvest time and gives it pretend boots before drawing its wonderfully crooked shape.

related_resources.reason: A real object becomes a pretend character through verbal play and an easily pictured shape.
A small repeated joke about trousers and boots is intended to be easy to anticipate during one-voice reading.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: The carrot had one thick top and two long orange roots below it.
